description: A six channel scanning mixer: a window is slid across the inputs and what falls under it is mixed to three outputs

params.text: Slides the scanning window across the six channels, from the first at 0V to the last at 5V
Attenuates the scan CV, from nothing to its whole range
Sets how wide the scanning window is, one channel at a time anticlockwise and all six together clockwise
Attenuates the width CV, from nothing to its whole range
Sets the level of all three outputs
Shapes the fade at the edges of the window, rounded anticlockwise and straight clockwise
Crossfades the output level between the LEVEL knob on its own and the knob scaled by the level CV
Sets the level of that channel

inputs.text: The signal of that channel, scaled by that channel's level trimmer before the scan reaches it
Multiplies that channel's level by the voltage here, 1V leaving it at the trimmer setting
Shapes the fade at the edges of the window, 0-5V added to the slope trimmer
Slides the scanning window across the six channels, attenuated by the scan attenuator
Widens or narrows the scanning window, attenuated by the width attenuator
Scales the output level, 10V leaving the outputs at the LEVEL knob setting and 0V silencing them

outputs.text: Channels one and two after the scan, at the level the LEVEL knob sets
All six channels after the scan, at the level the LEVEL knob sets
Channels five and six after the scan, at the level the LEVEL knob sets
